experiments.name: Fixed windows vs semantic segmentation
experiments.input: Full source, canonical ASR and audio, hidden atomic/chapter annotations
experiments.arms: A fixed windows (use pinned Director window/stride), B semantic units; C oracle segmentation diagnostic
experiments.output: Unit spans, proposal roster and inspected coverage
experiments.metrics: Boundary P/R/F1, complete-thought rating, recall@K and union footage, downstream approved yield
experiments.gate: Segmentation gain must improve downstream recall/yield or efficiency, not only boundary F1; no loss of quiet/silent recall
experiments.ablations: Remove hierarchy; fixed-length matched windows; lexical change-point

experiments.name: Nearby vs global context
experiments.input: Same anchor and initial IDs, frozen index, hidden evidence/needs
experiments.arms: Local ± window vs flat BM25/dense/RRF global; hierarchy/graph separately; oracle evidence diagnostic
experiments.output: Read evidence IDs, retrieved intervals and conclusion
experiments.metrics: Need closure, essential evidence recall, false citations, unnecessary retrieval, latency/cost
experiments.gate: Improve closure at matched calls/tokens/read footage with no worse faithfulness
experiments.ablations: No reranking; no hierarchy; raw rescue; no graph

experiments.name: Supplied vs autonomous investigation
experiments.input: Same candidate and initial observed IDs, hidden needs and queries
experiments.arms: Gold-query oracle upper-bound, autonomous one-shot, autonomous iterative; same backend
experiments.output: Generated needs, query history, read IDs, stop reason
experiments.metrics: Need F1, closure, query rubric, early stop, false stop, no-support correct stop, cost
experiments.gate: Autonomous beats local/no-investigation, oracle gap documented; no gold leaks
experiments.ablations: No need detector; no follow-up; no stop rule

experiments.name: Heuristics vs semantic interest
experiments.input: Fixed common candidate roster; all outputs unseen by initial annotators
experiments.arms: Audio/chat heuristic, transcript semantic, speech/audio fusion, optionally replay-pretrained
experiments.output: Rank scores, selected up to 3, calibrated probabilities if supported
experiments.metrics: Human pair preference, AP of independent interestingness, approved distinct yield, quiet slices, negative FP
experiments.gate: Improve paired preference/yield without hard-gate regression; no fixed category whitelist
experiments.ablations: Text-only, audio-only, chat missing, remove replay model

experiments.name: Implicit vs verified narrative
experiments.input: Same anchors and retrieval evidence budget; independent edge gold
experiments.arms: Implicit reasoning, typed relations verified; oracle node/edge diagnostic
experiments.output: Directed edge list, support IDs, relation confidence, closure groups
experiments.metrics: Typed edge macro/micro F1 incl negatives; essential relation recall; removal/restoration, faithfulness
experiments.gate: Gain on remote dependencies and qualification without higher unsupported claim rate
experiments.ablations: Remove edge verification; no long-range edges; proximity-only

experiments.name: Fixed padding vs contextual closure
experiments.input: Same candidate anchors, source, campaign, allowed durations
experiments.arms: Pinned baseline padding vs evidence closure; oracle dependencies diagnostic
experiments.output: Proposed and snapped intervals, required group coverage, rejected reason
experiments.metrics: Paired-region validity, closure, interval-specific human faithfulness, duration/excess, technical cuts
experiments.gate: Improved valid faithful intervals; no qualification omissions; no more forced clips
experiments.ablations: No conditional groups; no snap recheck; no alternative pair search

experiments.name: Heuristic vs semantic multimodal discovery
experiments.input: Same full VOD, synchronized available modalities; visual frames sampled with frozen policy
experiments.arms: Audio/motion heuristic, speech semantic, visual semantic, budget-balanced lane fusion
experiments.output: Lane provenance, excluded lanes, candidate ranks, frame/time logs
experiments.metrics: Open event recall at K and footage budget, silent/quiet recall, missing-modality coverage, cost
experiments.gate: Improve discovery in neglected slices without sacrificing overall yield or violating budget
experiments.ablations: Remove visual lane; uniform vs targeted frames; no chat; no lane fairness

experiments.name: Existing vs integrated
experiments.input: Same locked roster, permissions, campaign, renderer, full source hash
experiments.arms: Pinned Keystone A/B/C/D descriptors as available plus integrated prototype; production baseline predeclared
experiments.output: Final 0–3 clips, full run logs and matched review packets
experiments.metrics: Primary distinct independently approved events/assigned VOD; paired slate preferences; all safety/technical/failure/cost guards
experiments.gate: Pilot-derived meaningful gain over baseline, no serious distortion, no coverage/budget regression; Nexus approval
experiments.ablations: Leave one component out (segmentation/memory/autonomy/interest/relations/boundaries/visual), cumulative ladder
